name: BEEHIVE
source:
The man was just an everyday salaried worker, but everything changed when he met As*ka (Ne*n Genesis Ev*ngelion) in the toilet of a bar that day.

Daughter R*i provoked a father's sexual thoughts more than his wife... but could he actually make love with his beloved little girl?

A schoolteacher forced his way into the girl's toilets to falsely accuse M*ri of smoking, just so he could inspect her body... and so it began...

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE079710.html]DLSite English[/url]]
translation:
这名男子只是一名普通的工薪族，但当他那天在酒吧的厕所遇到阿斯卡（新世纪福音战士 饰）时，一切都改变了。

女儿R*i比他的妻子更能激发父亲的性想法……但他真的能和他心爱的小女孩做爱吗？

一名学校老师强行进入女孩的厕所，诬告M*ri吸烟，只是为了检查她的身体……事情就这样开始了……
